examples.text: The study shows（show的第三人称单数形式） that most people do not react as strongly as expected.
examples.translation: 研究表明，大多数人的反应并没有预期中那么强烈。
examples.speechText: The study shows that most people do not react as strongly as expected.

examples.text: A travel agent can give you information on special economy fares for trains, buses and planes.
examples.translation: 旅行代理可以向你提供火车、汽车和飞机的特价经济票价信息。
examples.speechText: A travel agent can give you information on special economy fares for trains, buses and planes.

examples.text: One paper looking into the ideal amount of sleep found that “Sleep duration recommendations issued by public health authorities help to inform the population of interventions, policies, and healthy sleep behaviors.”
examples.translation: 一篇探讨理想睡眠时长的论文指出：“公共卫生部门发布的睡眠时长建议，有助于让公众了解相关的干预措施、政策以及健康的睡眠行为。”
examples.speechText: One paper looking into the ideal amount of sleep found that “Sleep duration recommendations issued by public health authorities help to inform the population of interventions, policies, and healthy sleep behaviors.”

examples.text: Some of us get angry easily, while others do not let anger control them.
examples.translation: 我们当中有些人很容易生气，而另一些人不会让愤怒控制自己。
examples.speechText: Some of us get angry easily, while others do not let anger control them.

examples.text: As the density of whales increased（increase的过去式）, their singing behaviors changed.
examples.translation: 随着鲸群密度增加，它们的歌唱行为发生了变化。
examples.speechText: As the density of whales increased, their singing behaviors changed.

examples.text: I felt very small when I realized（realize的过去式） the hugeness of the universe.
examples.translation: 当我意识到宇宙如此浩瀚时，便感到自己十分渺小。
examples.speechText: I felt very small when I realized the hugeness of the universe.

examples.text: This worry often leads people to think that the other person expects something big in return.
examples.translation: 这种担忧常常让人以为，对方期待得到丰厚的回报。
examples.speechText: This worry often leads people to think that the other person expects something big in return.

examples.text: The road was wet this morning.
examples.speechText: The road was wet this morning.

examples.text: Records suggest that backward walking has been part of traditional exercise routines（routine的复数形式） for centuries.
examples.translation: 记录表明，倒着走几百年来一直是传统锻炼方式的一部分。
examples.speechText: Records suggest that backward walking has been part of traditional exercise routines for centuries.

examples.text: You will never gain success unless you are fully devoted to your work.
examples.translation: 除非你全身心投入工作，否则永远不会取得成功。
examples.speechText: You will never gain success unless you are fully devoted to your work.

examples.text: These payments to the poor are called welfare.
examples.translation: 这些发给穷人的款项被称为福利金。
examples.speechText: These payments to the poor are called welfare.

examples.text: In many cases, forgiveness comes naturally, making the worry unnecessary.
examples.translation: 在许多情况下，原谅是自然而然发生的，因此这样的担忧并无必要。
examples.speechText: In many cases, forgiveness comes naturally, making the worry unnecessary.

examples.text: Under no circumstances shall we cancel the party.
examples.translation: 无论在什么情况下，我们都绝不会取消聚会。
examples.speechText: Under no circumstances shall we cancel the party.

examples.text: Nowadays, we still have a collecting instinct.
examples.translation: 如今，我们仍然保留着收藏的本能。
examples.speechText: Nowadays, we still have a collecting instinct.
